title: CI Observe — Test history
description: One E2E test over time: duration, results, where its time goes, what it waits for and why it fails.

list.name: days
list.label: Window
list.description: How far back to look. 'vs before' compares with the same span just before it.

list.name: suite
list.label: Suite
list.query: All suites : all,VMaaS : vmaas,CaaS : caas,BMaaS : bmaas
list.description: The VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS E2E suites.

list.name: trigger
list.label: Started by
list.query: Any trigger : all,Pull requests : pr,Merge queue : merge_queue,Scheduled : scheduled,Manual : manual
list.description: Pull request suite runs, merge-queue runs, the scheduled runs on main, or manual runs.

list.name: repo
list.label: Repository
list.description: The repository whose CI started the run.

list.name: test
list.label: Test
list.description: Every test that ran in the window, the most time-consuming first. Type to search.

options.content: **One test over time.** Pick the *Test* above: type to search; the list starts with the tests that take the most time. Durations and results come from every run's JUnit report. Where the test's own time goes (setup, waiting for the product, test actions, teardown) comes from the recorded runs' traces.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Runs of this test. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Failure rate
panels.description: Failed runs ÷ runs. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Typical duration
panels.description: The median duration. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Slow runs take
panels.description: The 90th percentile: 9 in 10 runs are faster. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Typical duration vs before
panels.description: The median now against the median of the previous window. Red: slower. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: percent change.

panels.title: Flaky commits
panels.description: Commits on which the test both passed and failed. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of commits.

panels.title: Duration of every run
panels.description: Each point is one run of the test: green passed, red failed. The line is the median per day. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: each run at its creation time; the median per UTC day, last $days days. Unit: duration.

panels.title: Passes and failures per day
panels.description: Runs of the test per day. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: one point per UTC day the runs were created, last $days days. Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Where this test's time goes
panels.description: The average recorded run of the test: setup (fixtures), waiting for the product (every poll_until wait), test actions (the rest of the test: CLI and API calls, assertions) and teardown. The parts add up to the test's duration. Population: recorded runs of the selected test, from their traces. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Where its time goes, per day
panels.description: The same split per day: a band that grows is the part getting slower. Population: recorded runs of the selected test, from their traces. Time: one point per UTC day the runs were created, last $days days. Unit: duration.

panels.title: What it waits for
panels.description: The test's poll_until waits, grouped by what they wait for: per recorded run, how long, and how often the wait timed out. Population: recorded runs of the selected test, from their traces. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration, count and percent.

panels.title: Fixtures it sets up
panels.description: Fixtures set up in this test's setup phase. A shared (session, package or module) fixture is charged to the first test that needs it. Population: recorded runs of the selected test, from their traces. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration and count.

panels.title: Why it fails
panels.description: The test's failure messages, grouped after replacing names, ids and numbers. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of failures.

panels.title: Every run
panels.description: Every run of the test, newest first. 'Run' opens the recorded run, or GitHub. Population: runs of the selected test, from the JUnit reports. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: time and duration as named.

value.title: Open the run (GitHub when it was not recorded)

panels.title: About these numbers
panels.description: What this page counts, over which window, what is missing or partial, and when each source was last written, as the API computed it. Population: the page's own population, named in the first column. Time: the window in the second column. Unit: text.
